Walkthrough

The agent-ops guidance now states that the free plan reviews PRs subject to an hourly limit. It defines when to use or remove the `cr-skip` label and when to request a review manually. **Changes: PR review guidance** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Review eligibility and follow-up**
`plugins/kleinbem-fleet/skills/agent-ops/SKILL.md`|The guidance describes the free-plan hourly limit and restricts `cr-skip` to eligible changes. It instructs users to remove the label and request a review if a later push exceeds the limits, and to request a review if none appears within 10 minutes.| **Estimated code review effort:** 1 (Trivial) | ~3 minutes **Change:** Other
Merge Risk: Moderate · previous review 4d314

The new cr-skip guidance tells agents to push a rule-breaking change before removing the label. An auto-merging PR could then merge sensitive changes without review. Reordering the steps to remove the label and disable auto-merge first closes the gap; the change is otherwise documentation-only.

performed_via_github_app.name: coderabbitai
performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
